title: Two-machine conductors: the lead follows the owner, and owner decisions cross only as GitHub records
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Two-machine conductors" replaces the per-repo priority (Air leads iOS, Neo leads web) with: whichever conductor the owner is directing leads both repos, the other finishes its in-flight work and takes only what the owner or the lead hands it, and either answers the owner fully in its own session.

AGENTS.md says an owner decision reaches the other conductor only as a GitHub record (a PR comment with the owner's words, owner-approved on the owner's instruction, task decisions in RF evidence), never as a peer message or relayed text; machine limits (Cloudflare on the Air, iOS CI runner on the Air) are unchanged.
"Who finishes a PR" follows the merge permission rather than who opened the PR.
web CLAUDE.md and the ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md pointers state the rule briefly and point to AGENTS.md.
nextAction: Owner reviews the draft PR; the ritmofit-ios pointer PR follows.
